I'm sorry it takes so long. Hope it will be soon…
I'm listening to an audiobook in the car right now by Thomas Bolander. He talks about how hard it is to imitate human spontaneity, conversations, small talk when making a chatbot and says many big companies have dropped them as online chat support because there is simply too much they don't respond to. I find it so interesting – I'm already a big fan of Julina and rooting for it/her 😉
